reviews.text: Just phenomenal from the minute you walk through the doors until you leave. Vogue loves coming.

I had a really positive experience getting Lordy castrated and couldn’t recommend the team enough! A special thank you to Poli, who was so informative, friendly and helpful throughout the whole process. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel reassured and comfortable leaving Lordy in their care. It made such a difference having someone so kind and knowledgeable to talk to. Thank you, Poli, for taking such good care of Lordy! X

Hi Misia, thank you so much for your kind words! We're delighted to hear we could help make a stressful situation feel a little easier for both you and Milo. It was a pleasure meeting him, and we're glad he enjoyed all the attention and treats

We had our first appointment with creature comforts yesterday with my dog Zeus, from the second you walk in the staff are so welcoming and chatty and a lovely atmosphere. The vet came out and sat with Zeus in the waiting area and was fussing him and getting him excited for his appointment which was lovely. When we got into the room she really listened to my concerns and explained everything clearly so I understood, she was great with Zeus and he was very happy to be there, absolutely amazing staff and vets. He got a goody bag for his first visit which was filled with treats, balls and his very own bandana which is a lovely touch! We are so excited to come back for our next visit

Whilst I was waiting there was a few dogs and owners that walked by and the receptionist ( sorry I forgot all the names ) let them in to say hello and have a treat, she really takes her time to get to know owners and the dogs and they dogs stop on their walks to say hello!

Such an amazing vets and I have already recommended them to my other friends!

Thank you again and we can’t wait to see you all soon!

Really can't recommend highly enough. Clean pleasant surroundings, great staff, vets, nurses, admin. Weekend appointments. Short notice appointments. So much of an improvement on our previous place.
The dog loves coming here. If we come past in the morning, heading elsewhere, and they're not open he sits in front of the door looking hopefully in..

Kiwi is normally really nervous at the vet, but she absolutely loved it here. There were treats and balls everywhere, she got on so well with the vet, and for once she didn’t seem scared at all. Lovely experience!

Truly the best vet service I have ever come across. Wonderful caring team, always offering a drink, a clean facility that smells really good.

Lots of clinic branches locally which was very useful for my new boy Jasper. Great monthly price and subscription benefits!

Special mentions to Alexandra who initially helped me get set up; Cassie who handled our first appointment with Jasper, gave him all the medication, treatment and scans that he needed and thoroughly explained each; Abi and Tilly for their super responsiveness and support on Jaspers neutering day, sending in pictures and calling to keep updated, whilst looking after him for the day.

Thanks again team, I made the right choice!
💜
We were greeted and welcomed. Vet was very friendly and professional. She explained clearly. Our questions were answered. I highly recommend them.
The membership system is quite useful when having a young puppy. Staff is always super friendly and professional. They always look after my dog with care and make her feel comfortable.

Another fabulous visit to these lovely vets.
All the staff are very friendly and professional and very animal centred. Thank you
Everything was good and lovely. Friendly staff.
Had lost my dogs travel documents and I quickly got an appointment and was immediately helped. Very friendly and accommodating staff. Thanks for the help!

Creature comforts were amazing at looking after our cat! We moved to them from another vet, and we have had the best experience with them. He was so well cared for and their regular communication with us meant we were kept up to date with how he was getting on during his care. The staff are incredibly kind and caring, and very knowledgeable, we couldn’t recommend them highly enough. Thank you for looking after RP for us!
Staff are really helpful and always happy to help. Have taken my puppy there twice and both times have been really good
Highly recommend, amazing team and super relaxing atmosphere both the pets and the owners
Hi Charlie, thank you so much for the 5 stars! We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review and we’re so pleased you had a great experience. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

Really pleased with my first experience visiting with my doggo Samson. He’s quite a nervous dog so I was a bit worried but it was a great environment for him and the staff were really friendly. The pricing is also transparent.
Samson came out with his tail wagging!
Really caring and professional with my Cane Corso. You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs and treated mine really well. Would definitely recommend creature comforts in Putney.
Hi Zeynep, thank you so much for the 5-star review!  We really appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

I couldn’t recommend Creature Comforts Putney highly enough. My cat Theo recently had dental surgery there and, as a very anxious cat mum, I was understandably worried about him going through the procedure. The whole team were absolutely wonderful from start to finish.
They were kind, reassuring and incredibly caring with Theo, and took the time to explain everything clearly and answer all of my questions. The aftercare and communication were also excellent, which made such a difference in the days following his surgery.
Theo was treated with so much care and compassion, and I felt completely confident that he was in safe hands. It’s clear that everyone there genuinely loves animals and cares about their wellbeing.
Thank you so much to the whole team for looking after my boy so beautifully. I’m incredibly grateful. ❤️
Lovely team and always very helpful. Have helped us fit in an emergency appointment to check over our dog when needed
It's like a spa for our pets 🐕 …

Hi Gabrielle, 
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are delighted to have earned your rating. We look forward to welcoming you and your pet again.

Hi Max, 
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are delighted to have earned your rating. We look forward to welcoming you and your pet again.
Fantastic vets and staff. Very welcoming, clearly care about your pet from the get go and I feel like I’m in excellent hands! Prices are very reasonable too unlike some others.

Hi Gordon, 
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are delighted to have earned your rating. We look forward to welcoming you and your pet again.

We had a lovely experience taking Maple for her first vet visit! The vet was incredibly helpful, knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything clearly. Maple was surprisingly relaxed throughout the whole appointment, which made her first visit so much easier. The practice was also really clean and welcoming. We’re so happy to have found a great vet for Maple! 🐾
An absolutely wonderful vet. Very kind, super helpful and great with my little dog. I couldn’t recommend more

As usual the team at Creature Comforts Putney were outstanding in every way!  I am lucky to have them as my local veterinary surgery.  They are friendly, professional and reassuring, and my puppy Benji loves them!

We had to have a pet put to sleep quite suddenly and, despite us not being registered with them, everyone at creature comforts was so kind, helpful, and accommodating right from initially phoning to enquire through to after the appointment. They took the time to explain everything clearly and didn’t rush us despite us coming in towards the end of the day and quite last minute. Would highly recommend.

I brought my very senior cat in for a consultation because she wasn’t herself & won’t let me touch her face & drooling.
My initial consult was arranged online with ease.
The first impression when I entered the clinic was good. The reception staff was welcoming & ambience of the waiting area was very calm, clean & comfortable.
The vet saw us after a short wait.
Because my cat was unwell & uncooperative, she gave her oral sedative  to be administered at home & advised I should bring her back after 3 hours for a closer examination.
Blood was taken & the initial diagnosis was bad gum disease & infection. Further treatment under GA was recommended  asap( GA scheduled for Tuesday) This was on a Friday.
An estimate treatment cost was given. Because they could not predict what would be required, the cost range was £500-2000 ish. I needed time to think over it carefully. Since I wasn’t on insurance, it was a very costly treatment schedule.
Over the weekend, my cat’s condition deteriorated & her face became very swollen. On Monday I took a photo & sent to Creature Comfort.
The team responded quickly & suggested they would carry out GA  straightaway.
The vet explained very clearly all the possible outcomes. I felt my cat was in safe hands.
Happily, the surgery went very well & my cat recovered very well. However my bill was towards the top end of the estimate!
All in all, I am very satisfied with Creature Comfort. The vets are very reassuring & explained everything well. The aftercare experience with the nurse was also excellent.
I would recommend CC
Had a very positive experience at this Vets. Betsy needed some Dental work and we were kept informed throughout the day, after care is fantastic. Would highly recommend.

They are the best! Everything is done so politely and professionally. They explain everything thoroughly with so much understanding which is always appreciated at stressful times. They’ve come to know my dog and his little quirks and anxieties and always do their absolute best to make him comfortable whenever he visits! Couldn’t recommend them more.

Eleonore was absolutely amazing with my puppy. She was kind, patient, and very professional. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made both me and my puppy feel comfortable throughout the visit. I truly appreciate her care and compassion. I highly recommend Eleonore to anyone looking for an excellent vet. Thank you so much!
The team at creature comforts are amazing. From when we walked in and were checked in by Sachi, to the appointment with Polly, we had a lovely experience
Our cat has a chronic condition- We’ve been many times to creature comforts and they’ve been amazing.

It was our first visit and I can not recommend it enough! It was a great experience. The vet answer all my questions (that were many) and she showed genuine interest and care.

Even at reception they were super friendly!

We are so happy to be with Creatures!

First time visit to Putney clinic with my dog and thought the vet I was introduced to would carry out a full annual check-up, as it was last year August a check up was done by previous vet.
To just examine around 10-15 mins and not even ask to put my dog on the examination table is not right. Vet just done a very short examination on the floor. Told me there’s another dog who needs to be sedated.

Such a great vet practice ❤️ We have a cat with an unfortunate habit of eating things she isn’t supposed to and they are so lovely and fit her in every time! Raquel is so nice and puts her at ease 🐈‍⬛ definitely recommend the subscription service …

Highly recommend. What a genuinely lovely place. And very reasonably priced. I actually paid less than I would have at the blue cross for injections, a microchip and worming/flea treatment. To top if off, the staff were an absolute delight. Thanks guys, you made a usually anxious trip an enjoyable one for me and my little pup. See you soon. 😊
Alway good in an emergency and very helpful for last minute appointment. Surgery clean and welcoming.

Amazing first experience at Creature Comforts Putney. The staff were incredibly friendly and took the time to explain everything in detail with great care. Even though my dog had a vaccination that day, he was very happy. The membership system they offer also makes the whole experience seamless.
Hi Paul, thank you for leaving us a 5* review. We are glad to hear you enjoyed your visit.

I’d like to thank the whole team for being so amazing during my cat Mozzie treatment and regular checkups! Since the first time I came to Creature Comforts in Putney, I felt in love with it! No just Mozzie loves being treated by you guys, I do appreciate my time in the clinic while having some coffee. A big thank you all!✨
Creature Comforts are in a different league to every other vet we have known.  From front of house, clinical care and comms, this is a brilliant vet!

We have a very anxious dog and asked that the vet gave her some space if it wasnt necessary to examine her and Poli was fab with her.  Gaining her confidence and making the experience for us as well as our dog a pleasure.  The set up is lovely, exceptionally clean and for a first time visit, our dog had no idea she was at a vets.  Service and friendliness was very appropriate and we 'all' felt very looked after - definitely would recommend!

I’ve never seen a dog so excited to go to a vet! My dog is so happy coming here, the reception is always lovely and welcoming. All the staff clearly love animals and the vets are highly competent and easy to talk through. The subscription helps me pop in whenever we’ve got any worries big or small. We've now got a very healthy puppy thanks to the team.

Was our first time at Putney branch today , my dog was treated so well, everything was explained so well and the costing was very fair compared to previous vets I have used . The treat wall is an amazing idea and so is the drinks for mummy’s and daddy’s.
I also took out membership, which gives you amazing discount on quite a lot of things !
I highly recommend them , my dog is very anxious normally but by the time we left was fairly comfortable and happy . Definitely going to take my furry baby back there when needed 👍🏻
First time here and have already joined the membership. Kind and caring staff - very transparent fees. Definitely giving up the Medivets of this world for Creature Comforts!
Really lovely team! Thank you

Since moving from central London, Putney is now our closest Creature Comforts. Norman was immediately at home with the treat wall and was really well cared for by the team. I suspect he'll be wagging his tail on his return, which considering it's the vet, says it all really!

My first visit and couldn’t praise the team more, I am so glad I brought my cat here and will definitely be staying with them! I’d recommend everyone to come, the monthly subscription is amazingly convenient and helpful
Took my puppy there for his first visit and he was so relaxed, wasnt anxious at all. The staff there are very friendly and nice.

The team at Creature Comfort Putney is absolutely wonderful! They are so loving and gentle with my senior cat, and always so kind and welcoming to us as pet parents. We always feel he is in safe, caring hands. We even signed up for their membership because we know he will always receive the best support and attention here. Thank you for taking such good care of him!
Very loving towards me pets would recommend them to anyone
Thank you
Great service. Comfortable space for our dog. She loves stopping in and saying hi and grabbing a treat.

Friendly courteous service, excellent value for money .
Also there are not many vets that offer complementary tea and coffee.
Also the creature comforts app is great for booking, rescheduling apts and you can change the apt yourself , you are in control.
5 star waiting area and consultation rooms.
Highly recommended.
I love coming to creature comforts and Dudley loves it too! The staff are so sweet and he always gets treats. The membership is also worth the money!
Amazing place. For the first time he wants to go the vet rather than staying outside shaking

We were previously at Creature Comforts Notting Hill, where we had an amazing experience, but after moving to Fulham we transferred our membership to the Putney branch.

The team at Putney has been equally fantastic. They take incredible care of our dog and always go the extra mile - including when they stayed after closing hours to help us during an emergency, for which we are immensely thankful.

The facilities are great, the team is amazing, and it’s clear how much they genuinely care about the dogs. Highly recommended!
My cat was relaxed and treated nicely and comfortable, my cat feel like she was at home .

Absolutely fantastic vets! We took our 8 month old rescue puppy in and the reception staff and vet were outstanding, so calm and encouraging.

So glad they've opened in Putney!
Both my dogs love this vet - vets and all staff are brilliant

Vet visits are stressful at the best of times, and for me personally (as someone with OCD and anxiety), they can be really overwhelming. From the moment we arrived, that all melted away. We genuinely didn't want to leave.

Dr Ele was absolutely exceptional. She took her time with us, explained everything thoroughly, and never once made us feel rushed. Her care and attention were second to none. I felt completely at ease leaving Sutro in her hands, knowing she was in the very best of care. We left with a full diagnostic breakdown and clear treatment options, which gave us so much peace of mind.

It started as a one-off appointment, but we’re totally convinced that we’re not going back to our old vet. We’ve joined the membership and love the chat option in the app.

Thank you, Dr Ele, Imre, and the whole team at Creature Comforts. You've made such a difference.
Lovely vet with really friendly and helpful staff, the interior is clean and bright, lots of space!
I highly recommend this clinic! So nice and professional treatment!
Fantastic service, incredibly friendly. My cats were so nervous and immediately settled thanks to the calming environment and experienced staff. From reception to vet, I couldn't ask for more.

Absolutely amazing! Had an emergency with my leopard gecko and although not their normal patient I had an appointment within 20 minutes!
The care and handling of my poorly guy was fabulous and medication was given for an infection.
Advice given to visit an exotic vet but I was so happy they were able to see him so quickly and hopefully the medication helps him to feel a bit better. Thank you!
Delightful vet visit! There is so much love and care at this clinic— Andi and I felt so at ease the entire time. Bringing her big brother in for a checkup soon! Thanks Courtney and Raquel!

Simply the best! We cannot stop telling people how fantastic this practice is and ALL its staff. The appointments don’t feel rushed, the examinations are fun and thorough and they instantly make you and your pet feel at ease. Our little Italian Greyhound used to hate the vet and it caused us so much turmoil when wanting to help him but not wanting him to hate the experience but we no longer have to worry! He loves all the staff here. Especially Raquel, Polly and Ele. Thank you team, you have something so special here
Great level of care at Creature Comforts Vets in Putney. Dr Poli and the team were lovely and took time to explain what was best for our cat!
They are always happy and help you, even when you have a difficult to adapt puppy ❤️

Creature Comforts has been a great find for us. The space itself is calm and thoughtfully designed, which makes visits feel much more relaxed than you’d expect from a vet. Our dog Honey genuinely enjoys going, and she’s always greeted with kindness (and many tennis balls + treats!)

The team are consistently warm, attentive, and clearly very experienced. They take the time to explain things properly without ever making it feel overwhelming, and you leave feeling reassured that your pet is in good hands.

Took my kitty today for his second jabs and it was another wonderful experience! He was calm and cared for throughout. The vets and veterinary staff are all absolutely wonderful and i couldn’t recommend higher for your fur babies needs 🤍 …

The staff are cheerful and friendly and there is a lovely atmosphere in all areas.
Our cat can be very nervous in strange environments and new people but the veterinarian had a very calming influence on him, he was totally relaxed very quickly and laying in the bottom half of his carrier.
We were well informed of any procedures that may be necessary and help was offered with discussing the finances with the insurance company.
We all came away happy and satisfied with our visit and our cat is acting as though nothing out of the ordinary had happened.
It was a very pleasant experience for my wife and I and Pip the cat, I can not recommend this veterinary practice enough.

Title: Amazing, supportive team — Cj made a full recovery
Rating: 5 stars

We cannot thank Creature Comforts Veterinary Practice (Putney) enough. Our kitten Cj was born with a rare syndrome swimmer/splay-leg syndrome and was unable to use his back legs — he dragged himself along by his front legs on his tummy. The vets and whole team were incredibly kind, calm and reassuring and gave clear, practical advice from day one. The practice’s physiotherapist showed us exactly how to massage Cj’s back legs used bandages to  support and strengthen Cj’s back legs. Creature comforts set up an intensive schedule of appointments so they could reapply bandages when Cj kicked them off and needed  clean dressing. We were at the practice nearly every day for a few weeks and met every member of the team whom are all passionate, helpful and positive. It was a long process, but thanks to their persistence, expertise and encouragement, Cj has recovered — he now runs and plays happily with his siblings. I’m so grateful to the Creature Comforts Putney team and team members from their other branches for their skill, patience and compassion.
Thanks to creature comforts all access membership this was so affordable
Highly recommended.

After highly unsatisfactory encounters with other vets I tried this place in desperation over a bank holiday weekend, expecting the worst. What a kind, caring and efficient team! Clearly animal welfare and customer care are highly valued here. So happy we came and we will be regular clients from now on.
Great physiotherapy session ‘
As always, Flora had a very warm welcome and enjoyed her visit. She was treated with kindness & expertise

I cannot recommend Creature Comforts Putney highly enough. Our beautiful cat needed some dental treatment, including extractions.  We were kept well informed while she was sedated and pre-op and post-op care were superb.  The staff are delightful and very reassuring and the environment is peaceful and calming for pets and owners alike.

Absolutely the best vets around. Our Vizsla, Moose, loves this vet and the staff there. Immediately once he walks through the door he is showered with treats and love.

The app is brilliant to ask questions, book appointments and manage any bills/vaccines.

Best part of it all is the £20 a month fee. Honestly, go on the website and look at the value you get for it, nothing else in London comes close
Great first experience. Even my dog loved it. Not least the snack wall and his new purple ball. What a wonderful practice with lovely staff and state of the art facilities. I wish I was a dog…

Today was our first time ever at a Creature Comforts practice. It is the most hygienic and cleanest veterinary practice I have ever seen, including television programmes. Stacey provided us with a tour around the entire practice and it was hugely comforting to know that should our baby boy ever need hospitalisation, then we were more than rest assured, that he would be looked after by both competent staff and the latest in high-tech equipment for all his veterinary needs.
Our 13 week old puppy, Hector, was greeted at the front door by Stacey and Abigail. They were so extremely friendly and welcoming.
All the staff are thoroughly professional, informative, reassuring, and simply plain excellent in their roles for Hector’s health care. They all have exemplary knowledge of behavioural issues and are superb providing us with great confidence in moving forward with Hector‘s progression with all aspects of his training.
Finally, we commend Stacey’s excellent photography skills with capturing our baby boy sporting his new Creature Comforts bandanna.
Very welcoming and kind love this place,and so does my dog

Brought my cat in for a weight and dental consultation. Visits to Creature Comforts are always calm and smooth, the receptionist kindly offered me a tea while I waited and the nurse was very patient in answering all my questions.
Amazing vet practice. Clean, clam and professional. Leagues ahead of the competition. This is the reason. I have moved to them and I'm really happy.
Our dog is very anxious at the Vets. The team at creaturecomfort has been amazing and patient since day 1.

The approach of Creature Comforts is a monthly subscription but then just drop in whenever.  My daxie was running in the park and pulled up suddenly and wouldn't walk/stand, clearly in pain.  I took her straight to my local Creature Comforts and the vet Ele saw her after 10 mins.  Calmed down the human (me) and took about 3 minutes of observation to diagnose - bee sting! Found the sting in the front leg and removed it and we left with no further treatment required.  Great to be able to drop in for reassurance and a simple solution.

Unfortunately my cat had to be euthanised - this is not the reason for one star.  The one star is for the way that while he was still in the consultation room pre injection they came chasing in for payment saying I would be sent the receipt. No receipt arrived. I messaged the next day via the app asking for receipt and was told it would be sent. Still no receipt. Today I called them again outlining the situation and was then asked why I wanted this receipt. I suggested they read the chat from yesterday. Given they claim to “care” I am very surprised that a “bereaved” owner should have to chase so much especially given how quick they were to secure payment pre death……this has totally ruined my view of this chain and would suggest potential clients avoid as it’s precisely at such times one would hope that they were professional caring and understanding.

Always a pleasure to visit the vets with Max & Peyton. The reception staff are great and the vet care above and beyond. Price is very fair compared with others and if you are on the pet plan it is even better.

Genuinely lovely team who are very knowledgeable and the app with transparent pricing and chat is so helpful.

One small suggestion worth passing on: a quick verbal summary at the end of each appointment - e.g. what was done, what's been prescribed and any costs not covered by membership - would go a long way.

On All Access, consultations are included but prescriptions/treatments aren't. A 30 second run down from the vet before you get to the desk to pay would make an already great experience seamless.

Highly recommend, just a small tweak away from being perfect.

Excellent service, a beautiful and very clean clinic, with professional and polite staff. I have three dogs, and Creature Comforts was recommended to me by my son, who also has a dog. Our dogs have received excellent care, and I feel very confident they are in safe, experienced hands

I changed to Creature Comforts as it was closer to home and my older cat needed regular treatment. Have been blown away with how attentive, kind and knowledgeable everyone has been. They made everything so much easier to deal with including interactions with the insurers. There's also an unlimited supply of Lick e lix which Teddy is very happy with! Can't recommend highly enough!

Thank you for taking the time with my anxious  5 year old black lab . First time she has had an annual check and vaccs without a muzzle as she has always had to have at other vets.
Also this meant I could actually talk to the vet about her instead of getting out a quickly a possible !
We felt well looked after so thank you  🤩

Sooo happy with Creature Comforts. We opted for the monthly payments which I wasn't sure about but the experience has been amazing and it was a great decision. Regular check ups, nail clipping if required and access when you need it - we had a minor emergency and were straight in on a Sunday afternoon. The staff are brilliant - professional, friendly - and the environment is calming. So happy that the opening of this brach coincided with the arrival of our puppy :)
Tremendously caring staff and very well organised practice. My elderly diabetic cat receives all the care she needs and I’m looked after as well - it’s a difficult condition to manage.
Hi Sara, thanks so much for leaving us a review. We’re so pleased to hear your visit went so well. We’re looking forward to taking great care of you and your pet.
5star everything , out cat happy too.

I recently registered with Creature Comforts in Putney and have had a brilliant experience so far. From the warm welcome at reception to the fabulous medical care my boy received. He was very comfortable and that is always my top priority. 5 stars!

We had a lovely first visit at Creature Comforts Putney. The staff were very warm, friendly, and welcoming, and Loki was clearly well taken care of. All of our questions were answered, and we felt really accommodated throughout the visit. Most importantly, Loki seemed to feel better after our first appointment, which gave us a lot of reassurance. Thank you so much to the team for taking such great care of Loki..we really appreciate it! (The free coffee is amazing ☺️)

Honestly the best vet I truly believe they put the pet first went in for some vaccinations we were greeted as usual with a smile definitely helps put your heart at ease vet visits can be nerve racking for both pet and owner but not here! Always such lovely faces and top tier veterinary care. We love yall! 💜 …

Hi Karim,
Thank you so much for the 5 stars — we really appreciate your support! ⭐

It means a lot to our team, and we’re so pleased you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon 🐾
An excellent service with great professionals!

i had to bring my poorly ageing cat Neko to the Urban vets. they were extremely kind and gave me options, but the best for poor Neko was to put her to sleep. The vet was very understanding and gave me options of  how this was done. i was left to say goodbye and she took her away. in under a week i received a lovely card with a kind message and Neko’s paw prints.Thank you so much for being so understanding.
More than Excellent staff, really friendly and knowledgable in every way
Went on a lovely dog walk organised by Creature Comforts Putney ending with pupachinos, nice to have the team also attend the walk - thanks Raquel, Courtney and Fu.

Had an emergency ( my beautiful fur ball swallowed some chocolate) the team were very quick and sufficient dealing with an emergency. My fluff was really taken care of and so was I. Definitely recommend

We had our dog Lillie spayed here on the 10th February 2026
The team kept us updated all the way with photos and messages.
Everyone is so dedicated, kind, helpful.
We are very happy that we have chosen Creature Comforts as our vet.
We love them all
Love Kim, David and Lillie
Perfect place, I would never change, Coco my dog loves them and that's the most important.

I can't thank the staff at Creature Comforts Vets Putney enough for being so professional and kind. Not only did they heal our baby cat, but they also gave us extra advice and caring messages and calls after our visit to check on him after our each visit. This means the world to us as first-time pet owners. You've been super helpful, and we've saved so much money on vet costs with your membership offer. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. Muffin's mum, Banaz

Had my first appointment here today with my cat Saffie and couldn’t have been more impressed. The staff were all genuinely lovely, the building/facilities were top-notch (special cat hidey-holes and wireless charges for humans etc), and the total cost was below what I expected thanks to the £20 a month payment scheme significantly reducing my bill.

Thank you everyone at Creature Comforts!
First appointment we had with Poppy today . She was great , nice to meet a new member to your team . Daisy left feeling much better

Recently our cat started coughing and sneezing really badly so we took him to Creature Comforts. Staff were lovely & friendly.But the vet told us it wasn't any sort of infection & antibiotics were def not the first step BUT would give them if that's what we would like. While telling us about the possible reason for his illness they casually threw possibility of cancer into the equation!!! They went on to say he needed some sort of scan plus other tests at a cost of £400 to £800. Any follow up treatment & Meds could be anywhere up to £2000. They also said his gums were "VERY sore", needing immediate attention.  We took him home to figure out how we could afford this. We then discovered we are eligible for treatment with The Blue Cross. The vet there took one look at our cats throat and said . . "Aw yes it looks very sore. He has an upper respiratory  Infection. And he will be fine after a few days on antibiotics & pain Meds.  We told her what the Creature Comforts vet had said and she smiled and shook her head. This all cost us £40. OK its not as sparklingly new and modern as Creature Comforts & other expensive vets but  its clean and the staff are fantastic & they know what they are doing. I saw a prog on TV some time ago all about how the prices of private vets are extortionate. They rely on our total devotion to our furry companions to go to any extreme to make them well again. I don't doubt the animals are well cared for but please make sure you pet is actually having treatment they actually need. Do this by having more than one opinion, if possible.

Just the best vet experience ever. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, and the vets are great.

The subscription model works really well for me, and I prefer it. Over the past few months, it's been a comfort (no pun intended) to just be able to see a vet on short notice whenever I needed without having to worry about paying a fortune each time.

I appreciate their friendliness and professionalism and my dog appreciates the free treats and excellent care.

We joined around a month ago and have had excellent care and advice. It’s reassuring that you can visit whenever you need to. Vets are consistent which you struggle with often at the big chain vets. We feel in safe hands and have recommended to friends

Such a lovely practice. Staff are lovely, practice is new and clean. The App is superb. My dog recently had a surgery and they called me and sent me a photo of her via the app when she was awake. Would happily recommend to any pet owner!
Our velcro puppy Happy loved visiting Creature Comforts. With lots of treats, cuddles and praise, he did not notice that he was treated and will definitely happily come back! 😊 …

To then bring her into a home with two other female kitties, add me with my worry wart AuDHD persona and as you can imagine, she was utterly overwhelmed and stressed. I had prepared a room to integrate slowly, but as I was settling her in Willow slipped through a tiny crack in the door and oh my Gosh Myla being scared and twice the size of her sister went full on postal kitty she devil. This morning I took Willow to see the very excellent registered Veterinary nurse Abigail to administer her wormer/ flea/tick tablets. I did not feel confident enough to do it the first time as I have always used pipettes. Again, the level of care, concern and kindness shown to both of us was phenomenal, so much so that I brought Missy and Myla (yes I got her in the carrier again miraculously 😂) to have theirs administered too.
